initial_value_shape: source-reported scalar only, preserve integer precision and literal0
number_domain_for_review: Dedicated closed-cell volume-content central scalar:0<=value<=100 inclusive, preserve original precision and literal0. This role is part-volume content, unlike water-absorption ratio. Unknown exact denominator/correction does not remove this upper bound. If future sources report outside range, retain source bytes and separately adjudicate anomaly or extension; do not clamp, repair or automatically admit. Bound alone does not establish denominator, standard formula, saturated state or compliance.
evidence_policy: All facts mandatory; unknown=null with notes and same inspected primary-document condition evidence; reported also primary method evidence.
method_class_for_review: Published experimental reference / source_reports_measurement / conventional method: source explicitly measured and computed with pycnometer; do not invent hidden reduction or derivation inputs.
guardrails: No reuse water,TGA,elongation or relative-uncertainty percent central units
Preserve conventional measurement wording, do not re-label as raw direct cell counting
No100-minus open fraction, density/porosity/water conversion or correction
Definitions enrichment revises same source cell, not new fact
Absolute amplitudes if ever reported must use same dedicated role; source four cells have no amplitude
Four-language presentation and complete query/resolve/export definitions
No geometry or direction default from scalar result
